question: The recently commissioned INS Taragiri belongs to which class of frigate, and which shipyard has built this potent platform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Project 17A; Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Raksha Mantri Shri Rajnath Singh commissioned INS Taragiri, the fourth stealth frigate of Project 17A, into the Indian Navy at Visakhapatnam on April 03, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Taragiri is the fourth platform of the Project 17A (Nilgiri-class) stealth frigates, designed by the Warship Design Bureau and built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL).**
 
• The warship has a displacement of approximately 6,670 tonnes and features over 75% indigenous content, involving more than 200 MSMEs.
 
• It is equipped with advanced stealth technology, reduced radar signatures, and a "Combined Diesel or Gas" (CODOG) propulsion system.
 
• The ship's weaponry includes BrahMos supersonic surface-to-surface missiles, medium-range surface-to-air missiles, and an indigenous anti-submarine suite.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Project 17A (Nilgiri-class)__

 __
 
• Context - A follow-on to the Project 17 (Shivalik-class) frigates with improved stealth features, advanced weapons, and sensors.
 
• Shipbuilders - The project is divided between Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL) and Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers (GRSE).
 
 
 
• Defence Exports & Economy__
 __
 
• Financial Milestone - India's defence exports reached an all-time high of Rs 38,424 crore in the Financial Year 2025-26.
 
• Trade - Approximately 95% of India's trade by volume and 68% by value is moved through maritime routes.
 
 
 
• Technological Features__
 __
 
• Stealth - Utilizes integrated hull construction and specialized radar-absorbent coatings to reduce Radar Cross-Section (RCS).
 
• Digital Infrastructure - The Navy now plays a critical role in securing undersea internet cables that carry the vast majority of global data.
 
 
 
• Indian Navy Leadership__
 
 
• Chief of the Naval Staff - Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi.
 
• Chief of Defence Staff - General Anil Chauhan.
